findings.evidence: src/jspace_observation/parser_v3_v2_schemas.py: PREDICTION_MANIFEST defines "members": {"type": "array", "items": {"$ref": PREDICTION_MEMBER}, "minItems": 0, "maxItems": 120} with no "uniqueItems" or identifier-uniqueness constraint. PREDICTION_MEMBER defines "case_id": _CASE_ID. The validator implements only whole-item uniqueness via `if schema.get("uniqueItems"):` and has no keyed-ID uniqueness rule.
findings.reproduction: Validate a prediction manifest containing two distinct member objects with the same `case_id` and different `position`, `source_digest`, `prediction`, or `member_digest`. Both members satisfy PREDICTION_MEMBER and the enclosing array has no uniqueness constraint keyed on `case_id`, so the duplicate identifier is accepted.
findings.residual_limitation: After adding and enforcing identifier-level uniqueness, the material still would not prove uniqueness constraints for identifier-bearing arrays not covered by the fix.
findings.title: Identifier-bearing schema arrays accept duplicate IDs

findings.evidence: infra/azure/parser_v3_v2_boundary/modules/privatelink.bicep: `resource existingStorage 'Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts@2023-05-01' existing = { ... }` only references the account and declares no `publicNetworkAccess: 'Disabled'`, network rules, or equivalent assertion. The same file's comment says `The existing Basic registry ...` and `The private Blob account already exists and already has public network access disabled`, but that state is not enforced by this template. infra/azure/parser_v3_v2_boundary/main.bicep passes the existing account into the private endpoint module without any public-access check.
findings.reproduction: Deploy this template against an existing storage account whose public network access is enabled. The Bicep declares the account as `existing`, creates a private endpoint, and does not refuse or update the public-access setting. The account can therefore remain reachable through its public endpoint while holding private material.
findings.residual_limitation: Even after adding the template control, public accessibility would still require Azure read-back evidence to establish the deployed state.
findings.title: Existing private storage is not mechanically configured or checked as private

properties_checked.evidence: src/jspace_observation/parser_v3_v2_entrypoints.py provides the registry and resolver, but the supplied material does not include all protocol call sites or container build/runtime wiring proving that no alternate path reaches a protocol step.
properties_checked.property: Every protocol step is reachable only through a registered container entrypoint.

properties_checked.evidence: src/jspace_observation/parser_v3_v2_entrypoints.py: `assert_container_command_is_registered` resolves the exact command and raises when `spec.role != role`; `resolve_entrypoint` requires exact tuple equality. tests/test_parser_v3_v2_boundary_iac.py: `test_a_command_that_is_not_registered_is_refused`.
properties_checked.property: A container command naming a different role than the role being run is refused.

properties_checked.evidence: src/jspace_observation/parser_v3_v2_entrypoints.py: `resolve_entrypoint` compares the complete command tuple and raises `EntrypointError`; `preflight` raises for names not in `ENTRYPOINTS`; `main` requires exactly one argument.
properties_checked.property: An unregistered entrypoint name, a module-form command, or an extra argument is refused rather than ignored.

properties_checked.evidence: src/jspace_observation/parser_v3_v2_entrypoints.py: `_guarded` calls `assert_config_registered`, `assert_identity`, `assert_no_ambient_credentials`, `assert_lanes`, and `assert_import_isolation` before `_PreflightComplete` or payload validation.

properties_checked.property: A role holding no managed identity is refused.

properties_checked.evidence: src/jspace_observation/parser_v3_v2_schemas.py: `_obj` sets `"additionalProperties": False`; `_assert_closed` raises when an object schema lacks `additionalProperties` and recursively checks object properties and array items.

properties_checked.evidence: src/jspace_observation/parser_v3_v2_schemas.py: `_sid` creates `/v1` identifiers, `_register` writes `$id`, `SCHEMA_DIGESTS` computes every schema digest, and `REGISTRY_DIGEST` binds the complete digest map. src/jspace_observation/parser_v3_v2_entrypoints.py: `assert_config_registered` requires `schema_registry_digest == schemas.REGISTRY_DIGEST`.
properties_checked.property: Every registered schema carries an explicit version and a bound digest.

properties_checked.evidence: Unknown fields and wrong versions are rejected by src/jspace_observation/parser_v3_v2_schemas.py, but duplicate identifier values are not. `PREDICTION_MANIFEST.members` has no `uniqueItems`, and `PREDICTION_MEMBER.case_id` is not checked for uniqueness. See finding B-01.
properties_checked.property: Schema validation rejects unknown fields, wrong versions, duplicate IDs, and partial sets.

properties_checked.evidence: src/jspace_observation/parser_v3_v2_entrypoints.py calls `schemas.assert_valid` through `_validate_each`, but the supplied material does not include the contents of tests/test_parser_v3_v2_schemas.py or all production/test validator call paths.

report.summary: The entrypoint registry and command matrix are substantially bound and fail-closed, and the schema registry is closed at object boundaries. I found two material defects: schemas do not enforce uniqueness of identifier-bearing records, and the Bicep does not configure or verify public-network disablement for the existing private storage account. Several deployment and dependency claims cannot be settled from the supplied public material because the lock contents, installation command, and Azure read-back are absent.
unverifiable_without_private_material: Azure read-back of public network access and private endpoint enforcement for the existing storage account.
The dependency lock contents and the exact dependency installation performed by Azure.
Complete test-suite history and whether any existing tests were removed, skipped, weakened, or xfailed.
Runtime behavior of Bicep deployments for incomplete or malformed roleImageDigests maps.
